name: scrumia-kotlin
description: The JVM/Android implementation slot for Kotlin — idiomatic Kotlin language rules: naming, null-safety, coroutines, data/sealed/value classes, object vs companion vs top-level, and visibility. Pinned to Kotlin language semantics, applicable to any Kotlin codebase (JVM, Android, KMP) without requiring Functional Programming or Multiplatform modules. Plugs in app by app.
